text: fib(10) makes 177 calls, fib(20) makes 21,891, fib(30) makes 2,692,537. What is the problem?
choices: The branches overlap, so the same subproblems are computed repeatedly
Two recursive calls per invocation is always too many
explanation: fib(5) needs fib(4) and fib(3), but fib(4) also needs fib(3). Nothing remembers a value already found. Branching is not the problem — size(tree) makes two calls per node and is efficient, because a tree's subtrees share nothing.
